notes.title: 6/13 Patch
notes.content:
[list]
[*]- Achievements now function locally. There's 53 of them, a dedicated page on the main and pause menus, and an audio cue upon unlocking them. Beating the game will allow you to see the requirements for hidden achievements when accessing from the pause menu. There is only one test achievement on Steam itself. The other achievements will not unlock through Steam at this time, but the systems are in place so that, once the final game releases, Steam will automatically add unlocked achievements to your account.

[*]- Rebalanced a lategame boss.

[*]- Removed the ability to hide the pause screen for screenshots when not on the default pause menu, to prevent issues if pressing Alt while remapping controls, etc.



[/list]

notes.title: 1/4/25 Patch
notes.content:
- Divas shrug off their stunned status faster when it's time to use their ultimate.
- Enemies who are supposed to have their stunned state reset now also have their frozen state reset at the same time. 

- Fixed bug deleting Agna's HP bar during phase 2 when restarting it from a checkpoint.
- Fixed bug causing Soma to repeat the phase 2 transition when being stunned quickly enough during phase 2.
- Fixed bug causing divas to not transition to phase 2 when being frozen.


- Increased horizontal bounds of Vaya's phase 2 arena. 
- Decreased cooldown of Vaya's phase 2 airships. 

- Slightly increased Soma's HP. She now has Agna's HP instead of Indra's.
- Increased Soma's attack cooldown.
- Increased startup and endlag of Soma's drill punch attack. 
- During phase 2, Soma's drill punch attack now only repeats once.
- Decreased Soma's max movement speed during her kick barrage.
- Slightly increased Soma's startup for her kick barrage.
- During the kick barrage, Soma now briefly stops right before the attack starts.
- Soma's tornado spin attack hitbox doesn't activate until she turns green.
- Decreased the followup clones during Soma's ultimate from 3 to 2.
- These clones come out slightly sooner.
- The vertical clones during the final portion of Soma's ultimate take slightly longer to follow up. 

- Diva mechanics are disabled during cutscenes.
- Diva strong attacks (the ones that darken the screen) no longer have their cooldowns ticking during dialogue.

- Added more pause checks to various stage gimmicks.

- Fixed visual bug causing Neon to run in place, or run into invisible walls after breaking Reactors at the end of Act 4 stages.

- Fixed visual bug with Nitra District's bottom storm cloud background asset.
- Fixed visual bug causing Divas to not flash or turn blue when frozen during phase 2.

- Enemies frozen by Lunar Freeze now take 1.5x knockback instead of 2.5x
- Bosses frozen this way now take normal knockback when unfrozen.

- Fixed potential softlock caused by KO'ing Agna during her ultimate. 
- Fixed visual bug causing Agna and Neon to careen to the left before her KO dialogue.

- Fixed bug where Resonance Breaker could be used against offscreen enemies.

notes.title: Playtest 12/12/24 Patch
notes.content:
- Swapped the order of Phospha District and Nitra District in the hub select, level select and training mode menus. (Phospha District is a bit easier overall than Nitra District so this order makes more sense.)

- Reduced the number of large spikes in Phospha District Act 1, most especially in the section right after the miniboss.
- Replaced the mole at the start of Phospha Act 1 with a wheel enemy.

- Adjusted some level design in Nitra Act 3 to be a bit easier. The fast aerial bumper segment no longer has you stop time first.
- Added some shield boxes to Nitra Act 3.

- Attempted to address issue where Vaya's second phase may rarely not start.
- The pink round drones in Nitra District that shoot down have had their fire rate cut in half.
- The tornado enemies in Nitra District overall move slower towards you.
- Slightly nerfed the damage output of Nitra District's gimmick, but its ease of use is the same.

- The penguin enemies in Hexane District now have their attack hitbox match their sprite.

- Adjusted the areas leading up to the boss arenas in Hexane and Nitra Act 4 to have their doors onscreen, and their pre-boss "tunnels" to take up exactly 1 screen.

- Added a couple tutorial billboards in some levels to show inputs for some gimmicks the (presumed) first time you encounter them. 
- All in-level button prompts now pulsate a bit.

- Dash Dodge (timestop) now triggers using either charge of dash, instead of requiring both. This restriction originally existed before stopping time zero'd out your dashes and you would otherwise be able to chain multiple timestops together within frames of each other. This kind of game break isn't as easy to do now, so stopping time should simply feel more consistent for everyone after this patch.

- Efficient Dash II upgrade has been changed to let your dashes recover during stopped time.
- Extreme Dash upgrade has been removed.

- Invincibility fully heals you now just because the visual overlay on your HP bar makes it look like it does that.

- Fireball Sting's dash ball is no longer treated as a stage hazard, removing most awkward interactions with enemies. 
- Lunar Freeze now only triggers on counter attacks (stopped time attacks) that stun enemies, rather than all break attacks.

- Phantom Dash now consistently goes to the last enemy hit regardless of if they are stunned or not.
- Phantom Dash puts you slightly farther away from enemies.
- Phantom Dash now only freezes enemies in place if they were already stunned.
- Phantom Dash now costs a dash charge because it is absurdly broken and is free combo real estate otherwise.

notes.title: Playtest Patch for 12/6/2024
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Game now just defaults to windowed; fullscreen has to be set manually in options or with Ctrl + F. This is to prvent inconsistencies where the game does fullscreen behavior while windowed.
[*]Deleting a save file now has a different transition and no longer returns to the demo menu.
[*]Fixed issue where sandbag (training room) stayed permanently suspended when dashing into it (it's supposed to freeze for a little bit, just not forever).
[*]The tutorial sandbag now is guaranteed to disappear when reaching 100%.
[*]Fixed issue where player fell through global hub warp pad during certain dialogue.
[*]Added an extra sign above the shop door in the global hub to make it more obvious.
[*]Reduced size of Gajjit's portrait sprite in the shop to better see prices

[*]Attempted to address issue where Aegis' hand in Central District Act 1 stops attacking when you get far enough away from it.
[*]Hogcopter (Central District Act 3) bombs can now be stopped and parried with attacks. This was originally intended functionality that wasn't working properly until a complete reprogramming. Normal attacks slow the bomb down until deflecting, while break attacks deflect the bomb immediately. Both actions knock it straight up regardless of attack direction.
[*]Hogcopter's bombs only spawn extra projectiles when the miniboss is below half health.
[*]Fixed issue where those bombs and its projectiles could keep moving in the buffer time before the game is fully paused.
[*]Fixed issue where the first boost ring after the Hogcopter fight didn't function immediately.
[*]Hazard Eye (Running "boss" in C.District Act 3) now has its laser beam forcefully delayed in areas of that level segment, and cannot fire its beam when it is offscreen. So it should no longer cheap you out when it first appears or when you otherwise can't react.

[*]Attempted to address issue where Hexane District's Spider enemies can clip through walls.
[*]Fixed a potential softlock in Hexane District Act 3 where you couldn't leave the small side room after grabbing a shield box due the tubes not working.
[*]Fixed potential softlock in Hexane Act 4 where you could get behind a box or drag it backwards into lava. Now, the box is guaranteed to respawn during the latter, and the player can fall into a tube to return to where they're supposed to be, for the former.
[*]The first shield box in Hexane Act 4 is properly attainable via the second attackable bomb in the level.
[*]Fixed issue where attackable bombs could be frozen with the Lunar Freeze skill/perk.
[*]Dash balls used via the Fireball Sting perk must be onscreen to deal damage, and starting a bossfight destroys all dash balls.
[*]Flame shield should now stop working only when the player runs out of shield points.
[*]Fixed issue where any explosion that damages enemies would immediately "stun" the enemy regardless of if its armor was broken or not.
[/list]
